column1: # The thought-group lines again, with the pauses written in: ElevenLabs hardly pauses at a
# comma, and these clips are about the pause. Run with 6 takes, so takes 4-6 are these
# (eleven_tts.sh keeps takes 1-3 from tts/stress-groups.tsv); pick_takes.py then keeps
# the take with the right number of clear pauses.

column2: If it rains tomorrow, <break time="0.35s" /> we'll stay at home.
I bought rice, <break time="0.3s" /> eggs, <break time="0.3s" /> onions, <break time="0.3s" /> and tea.
When I arrived at the station, <break time="0.35s" /> the train had already left.
My sister, <break time="0.3s" /> who lives in Dhaka, <break time="0.3s" /> is a doctor.
The teacher, <break time="0.3s" /> said the student, <break time="0.3s" /> is lazy.
